title: Structured Output JSON Schema – Test Cases (SDK parity table)
content:
Purpose
- Single source of truth for structured-output (schema-constrained JSON) test cases used by:
  - SDK example tests ("copy/paste" snippets should pass)
  - Golden transcript tests (streaming -> final JSON parse)
  - Docs snippets validation (where feasible)

Scope
- These test cases focus on: (1) JSON Schema constraints we recommend publicly, (2) failure modes we see in support tickets, (3) consistent validation + parse behavior across Python/TS/Go.
- Non-goal: Exhaustive JSON Schema conformance. We intentionally avoid exotic keywords for user-facing examples.

Important behavioral contract (for tests)
1) We validate AFTER the final assistant message is assembled.
   - Do NOT try to parse/validate partial JSON chunks during streaming.
   - If we want to demonstrate incremental UX, we do it as "buffer + attempt parse" but tests should assert we only accept the final validated object.
2) We treat the model output as untrusted.
   - Always parse JSON strictly.
   - Then validate schema strictly.
3) Failure handling guidance (examples + tests)
   - If parsing fails: retry once with a "return ONLY valid JSON" nudge (or do a non-streamed retry), then fail with a helpful error.
   - If schema validation fails: retry once with a "fix these fields" nudge including validation errors.

SDK validation/parse implementation (current recommended)
Python
- Parsing: json.loads(text)
- Validation: jsonschema.Draft2020Validator(schema).validate(obj)
- Notes: Keep error messages stable-ish for tests (assert substring categories, not full path formatting).

TypeScript
- Parsing: JSON.parse(text)
- Validation: Prefer AJV (JSON Schema) in examples/tests. Zod is fine for app code but keep parity with JSON Schema docs.
- Notes: AJV config should be strict: allErrors=true, strict=true, allowUnionTypes=false (unless explicitly testing unions).

Go
- Parsing: encoding/json Unmarshal into interface{} then remarshal canonical JSON for snapshot (optional)
- Validation: gojsonschema or santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema (pick one per repo; avoid mixing)
- Notes: Report validation errors as a joined string list; tests should verify key phrases + failing field paths.

Canonical schema patterns we test
- object root with properties + required
- enums
- arrays with minItems/maxItems + item schema
- string constraints: minLength, pattern (simple)
- numeric constraints: minimum/maximum
- additionalProperties: false (strict)
- nullable handling: use oneOf with {"type":"null"} OR omit field; do not rely on OpenAPI nullable

Known pitfalls reflected in cases
- Model adds commentary outside JSON
- Model returns a JSON string containing JSON (double-encoded)
- Truncated JSON (stream disconnect / max tokens)
- extra keys despite additionalProperties=false
- wrong types ("42" vs 42)

Table columns
- case_id: stable identifier used by tests
- category: parse | schema | streaming | robustness
- description: what this catches
- schema: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12 style)
- sample_output: raw assistant message content (as a string)
- expected: VALID | INVALID_PARSE | INVALID_SCHEMA
- expected_error_contains: substring(s) tests should assert (avoid full exact match)
- sdk_notes: python/ts/go specifics
- retry_strategy: none | parse_retry | schema_retry

================================================================================
TEST CASES (copy/paste table)
================================================================================

Row format (pipe-delimited):
case_id | category | description | schema | sample_output | expected | expected_error_contains | sdk_notes | retry_strategy

SO-001 | schema | Minimal valid object w/ required fields | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"confidence":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}},"required":["answer","confidence"]} | {"answer":"Redwood Inference provides hosted, dedicated, and private LLM inference.","confidence":0.84} | VALID |  | Canonical happy-path. Use in quickstarts smoke tests. | none

SO-002 | schema | Rejects additionalProperties (model adds "notes") | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"]} | {"answer":"ok","notes":"extra"} | INVALID_SCHEMA | additionalProperties | All SDKs must fail strictly. | schema_retry

SO-003 | schema | Missing required field | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"},"confidence":{"type":"number"}},"required":["answer","confidence"]} | {"answer":"ok"} | INVALID_SCHEMA | required | Assert error mentions missing "confidence". | schema_retry

SO-004 | schema | Wrong type: confidence returned as string | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"},"confidence":{"type":"number"}},"required":["answer","confidence"]} | {"answer":"ok","confidence":"0.7"} | INVALID_SCHEMA | type | Support ticket analog: users forget numeric. | schema_retry

SO-005 | parse | Commentary outside JSON (common model behavior) | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"]} | Sure! Here you go:\n{"answer":"ok"} | INVALID_PARSE | JSON | For examples: show retry by asking for ONLY JSON. | parse_retry

SO-006 | parse | Trailing commas (invalid JSON) | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"]} | {"answer":"ok",} | INVALID_PARSE | JSON | Ensure we do not attempt to "fix" JSON automatically in SDK examples. | parse_retry

SO-007 | parse | Double-encoded JSON string (JSON containing JSON as a string) | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"]} | "{\"answer\":\"ok\"}" | INVALID_SCHEMA | type | Parsing succeeds -> yields string, then schema fails (expects object). Mention as pitfall in docs. | schema_retry

SO-008 | schema | Enum constraint respected | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"sentiment":{"type":"string","enum":["positive","neutral","negative"]}},"required":["sentiment"]} | {"sentiment":"happy"} | INVALID_SCHEMA | enum | Error text differs by validator; assert contains "enum" or "allowed". | schema_retry

SO-009 | schema | Pattern constraint (simple) | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"ticket_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^SUP-[0-9]{5}$"}},"required":["ticket_id"]} | {"ticket_id":"SUP-18436"} | VALID |  | Keep patterns simple; avoid catastrophic regex. | none

SO-010 | schema | Pattern failure | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"ticket_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^SUP-[0-9]{5}$"}},"required":["ticket_id"]} | {"ticket_id":"18436"} | INVALID_SCHEMA | pattern | Ensure message highlights pattern mismatch. | schema_retry

SO-011 | schema | Array w/ minItems + item type | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"steps":{"type":"array","minItems":2,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}}},"required":["steps"]} | {"steps":["buffer stream","validate JSON"]} | VALID |  | Used for agentic workflow step lists. | none

SO-012 | schema | Array too short | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"steps":{"type":"array","minItems":2,"items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["steps"]} | {"steps":["only one"]} | INVALID_SCHEMA | minItems | Assert mentions minItems / too few items. | schema_retry

SO-013 | schema | Nested object with strict keys | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"user":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"age":{"type":"integer","minimum":0}},"required":["name"]}},"required":["user"]} | {"user":{"name":"Asha","age":31}} | VALID |  | Verify nested additionalProperties handled. | none

SO-014 | schema | Integer vs number mismatch | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"count":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["count"]} | {"count":1.2} | INVALID_SCHEMA | integer | Go validators sometimes say "expected integer"; assert contains "integer" or "type". | schema_retry

SO-015 | schema | Nullable field via oneOf | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"resolution":{"oneOf":[{"type":"string","minLength":1},{"type":"null"}]}},"required":["resolution"]} | {"resolution":null} | VALID |  | We recommend oneOf for nulls; test parity. | none

SO-016 | parse | Truncated JSON (missing closing brace) | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"]} | {"answer":"ok" | INVALID_PARSE | EOF | Mirrors streaming disconnect + token limit. | parse_retry

SO-017 | robustness | Large strings allowed but schema still enforces minLength | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"summary":{"type":"string","minLength":20}},"required":["summary"]} | {"summary":"too short"} | INVALID_SCHEMA | minLength | Keep length thresholds small in tests for readability. | schema_retry

SO-018 | schema | maxItems enforcement | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"items":{"type":"array","maxItems":3,"items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["items"]} | {"items":["a","b","c","d"]} | INVALID_SCHEMA | maxItems | Ensure validators catch this consistently. | schema_retry

SO-019 | schema | number bounds (minimum/maximum) | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"confidence":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}},"required":["confidence"]} | {"confidence":1.3} | INVALID_SCHEMA | maximum | Tie to confidence field in docs. | schema_retry

SO-020 | parse | Leading BOM/whitespace should be OK | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"]} | \n\n  {"answer":"ok"} | VALID |  | All SDK parsers should accept leading whitespace. | none

SO-021 | streaming | Tool output accidentally included (non-JSON) before JSON | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"result":{"type":"string"}},"required":["result"]} | TOOL_RESULT: search_docs(ok)\n{"result":"ok"} | INVALID_PARSE | JSON | Mirrors agent loops where dev concatenates tool logs. Emphasize clean assistant content. | parse_retry

SO-022 | schema | Disallow empty strings | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"title":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"required":["title"]} | {"title":""} | INVALID_SCHEMA | minLength | Useful for UI-friendly structured fields. | schema_retry

SO-023 | schema | oneOf union for a small tagged union object (allowed but keep simple) | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"action":{"oneOf":[{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"type":{"const":"email"},"to":{"type":"string","minLength":3}},"required":["type","to"]},{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"type":{"const":"slack"},"channel":{"type":"string","minLength":2}},"required":["type","channel"]}]}},"required":["action"]} | {"action":{"type":"email","channel":"#alerts"}} | INVALID_SCHEMA | required | We should document unions as "advanced"; keep tests to ensure validators agree. | schema_retry

SO-024 | schema | Correct tagged union (email) | {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"action":{"oneOf":[{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"type":{"const":"email"},"to":{"type":"string","minLength":3}},"required":["type","to"]},{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"type":{"const":"slack"},"channel":{"type":"string","minLength":2}},"required":["type","channel"]}]}},"required":["action"]} | {"action":{"type":"email","to":"ops@redwoodinference.com"}} | VALID |  | If any SDK validator struggles here, we may drop union from public guidance. | none

================================================================================
Notes for implementing automated tests
================================================================================
- Snapshot strategy:
  - Store sample_output exactly as returned (string).
  - Parse -> get obj.
  - Optionally canonicalize JSON for stable snapshots (recommended for Go).

- Assertions:
  - expected == VALID: parse succeeds + validation succeeds.
  - expected == INVALID_PARSE: JSON parse throws.
  - expected == INVALID_SCHEMA: parse succeeds, validation throws.
  - expected_error_contains: assert any substring match in normalized error string.

- Error normalization (so tests aren’t flaky):
  - Python: catch json.JSONDecodeError vs jsonschema.ValidationError; normalize to "PARSE:" or "SCHEMA:" prefix.
  - TS (AJV): map ajv.errors to a compact string list like "path=/confidence keyword=type".
  - Go: flatten validation errors to lines "path=/confidence keyword=type".

- Retry tests (optional):
  - Only run retry_strategy tests in integration/e2e where we actually call a model.
  - Unit tests should just cover parse/validate behavior deterministically.

Open questions / TODOs
- Decide final Go validator library (gojsonschema vs santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema) per repo; keep consistent across examples and tests.
- Confirm whether we document Draft 2020-12 explicitly in public docs or just "JSON Schema". (PM-413)
- Confirm model support matrix: some models obey additionalProperties=false better than others; examples should mention "validate and retry" as the reliable path.
